resources.string: The text sends a description with links; the install file sends the app itself — useful for someone without internet.

GT-BMS (GNUTUX BMS): a free Android app that reads smart lithium batteries over Bluetooth — Bestway, JBD, JK, Daly, PowerQueen and more. State of charge, every cell voltage, temperatures, protection alerts, event history, and alarms for full charge and low battery. No ads, no tracking, no account.
